statement.ru: Саблезубый тигр — близкий родственник современного тигра.
statement.en: The sabre-toothed tiger was a close relative of today's tiger.

why: Smilodon belongs to the extinct Machairodontinae and is not closely related to the tiger or any living cat.

statement.ru: Мозг неандертальца был в среднем больше нашего.
statement.en: A Neanderthal's brain was on average bigger than ours.

why: Neanderthal brains averaged about 1640 cc in males, higher than any living human population.

statement.ru: Птеродактили — это летающие динозавры.
statement.en: Pterodactyls are flying dinosaurs.

why: Pterosaurs are a separate group of reptiles; the definition of dinosaurs excludes them.

statement.ru: Ихтиозавры откладывали яйца на берегу, как черепахи.
statement.en: Ichthyosaurs laid their eggs on the shore, like turtles.

why: Ichthyosaurs were viviparous: they gave birth to live young in the sea.

statement.ru: Вход в пещеру Ласко с древними рисунками нашли благодаря собаке.
statement.en: The entrance to Lascaux cave and its ancient paintings was found thanks to a dog.

why: In 1940 18-year-old Marcel Ravidat found it when his dog Robot investigated a hole.

statement.ru: Каменный век назвали так, потому что люди жили в каменных домах.
statement.en: The Stone Age got its name because people lived in stone houses.

why: It is named for stone tools, the main material for tools in that period.

statement.ru: Длина древней змеи титанобоа — больше 12 метров.
statement.en: The ancient snake Titanoboa was more than 12 metres long.

why: Titanoboa, from about 60 million years ago in Colombia, is estimated at 12.8 m or more.

statement.ru: Мамонт — прямой предок современных слонов.
statement.en: The mammoth is the direct ancestor of today's elephants.

why: Mammoths were a sister line to elephants; mammoths and Asian elephants are closest relatives, not ancestor and descendant.

statement.ru: У «ледяного человека» Эци, найденного в Альпах, были татуировки.
statement.en: Ötzi the Iceman, found in the Alps, had tattoos.

why: Ötzi has 61 tattoos made of black lines.

statement.ru: Первым животным, которое приручил человек, была кошка.
statement.en: The first animal humans tamed was the cat.

why: The dog was the first species to be domesticated, over 15,000 years ago, long before the cat.

statement.ru: Флейтам из птичьих костей больше 40 000 лет.
statement.en: Flutes made of bird bones are more than 40,000 years old.

why: Aurignacian bone and ivory flutes from German caves date to 43,000 to 35,000 years ago.

statement.ru: Неандертальцы ходили сутулясь, полусогнувшись, как обезьяны.
statement.en: Neanderthals walked stooped and half-bent, like apes.

why: A myth from Boule's 1908 slouching reconstruction; Neanderthals walked upright like us.

statement.ru: Глаза трилобитов были с линзами из минерала — кальцита.
statement.en: Trilobite eyes had lenses made of a mineral, calcite.

why: Even the earliest trilobites had compound eyes with lenses made of calcite.

statement.ru: Огнём первыми научились пользоваться люди нашего вида.
statement.en: People of our own species were the first to use fire.

why: Homo erectus used fire about 1 million years ago or earlier; Homo sapiens appeared about 300,000 years ago.

statement.ru: Птерозавры были покрыты чем-то вроде пушистой шерсти.
statement.en: Pterosaurs were covered in something like fuzzy fur.

why: Pterosaurs had coats of hair-like filaments called pycnofibers over their bodies and wings.

statement.ru: Зубы мегалодона в старину считали окаменевшими языками.
statement.en: In the old days, megalodon teeth were thought to be petrified tongues.

why: Pliny described them as petrified tongues, 'glossopetrae'; later tradition said serpents' tongues.

statement.ru: В последний ледниковый период льдом была покрыта вся Земля.
statement.en: In the last Ice Age the whole Earth was covered in ice.

why: Ice sheets covered much of northern North America, Europe and Asia; the tropics stayed ice-free.

statement.ru: Когда-то жили многоножки длиной больше двух метров.
statement.en: Millipedes more than two metres long once lived on Earth.

why: Arthropleura reached at least 2 m, possibly over 2.5 m: the largest land arthropod ever.

statement.ru: Колесо изобрели раньше, чем лук и стрелы.
statement.en: The wheel was invented before the bow and arrow.

why: Arrows date back over 60,000 years; the wheel appeared only about 3500 BC.

statement.ru: Рисунки бизонов в пещере Альтамира первой заметила восьмилетняя девочка.
statement.en: The bison paintings in the Altamira cave were first noticed by an eight-year-old girl.

why: In 1879 María, the eight-year-old daughter of Sautuola, led him to the paintings on the ceiling.

statement.ru: Плезиозавры дышали под водой жабрами.
statement.en: Plesiosaurs breathed underwater with gills.

why: Plesiosaurs were reptiles that breathed air with lungs.

statement.ru: Древние ленивцы бывали размером со слона.
statement.en: Ancient sloths could be the size of an elephant.

why: Megatherium americanum was an elephant-sized ground sloth of about 4 tonnes.

statement.ru: Туристов до сих пор пускают в настоящую пещеру Ласко.
statement.en: Tourists are still let into the real Lascaux cave.

why: The original cave has been closed to the public since 1963; visitors see replicas.

statement.ru: Лезвия из вулканического стекла пробовали в хирургии вместо скальпеля.
statement.en: Blades of volcanic glass have been tried in surgery instead of scalpels.

why: Obsidian fractures to very sharp edges and has been used experimentally as scalpel blades.

statement.ru: Глиптодон — гигантская древняя черепаха.
statement.en: The glyptodon was a giant ancient tortoise.

why: Despite its shell, Glyptodon was a large armadillo, a mammal.

statement.ru: Морской ящер мозазавр — родственник ящериц и змей.
statement.en: The sea monster mosasaur was a relative of lizards and snakes.

why: Mosasaurs belong to Squamata, the order of lizards and snakes; they looked like monitor lizards.

statement.ru: Древние предки лошадей были крупнее современных лошадей.
statement.en: The ancient ancestors of horses were bigger than today's horses.

why: Eohippus, 52 million years ago, was about the size of a fox.

statement.ru: Из Англии во Францию когда-то можно было дойти пешком.
statement.en: You could once walk from England to France.

why: In the Ice Age low seas left dry land (Doggerland) joining Britain to the continent.

statement.ru: Трилобиты — это древние насекомые.
statement.en: Trilobites were ancient insects.

why: Trilobites were marine arthropods of their own class, not insects; they lived in the sea.

statement.ru: Бивни мамонта бывали длиннее трёх метров.
statement.en: Mammoth tusks could be more than three metres long.

why: The longest known woolly mammoth tusk is 4.05 m along the curve.

statement.ru: В Индонезии жили древние люди ростом около метра.
statement.en: Ancient people about one metre tall lived in Indonesia.

why: Homo floresiensis, the 'Hobbit' of Flores island, stood about 1.1 m tall.

statement.ru: Жизнь на Земле появилась примерно тогда же, когда динозавры.
statement.en: Life on Earth appeared at about the same time as the dinosaurs.

why: Life is at least 3.5 billion years old; dinosaurs appeared only about 230 million years ago.

statement.ru: Рога древнего гигантского оленя в размахе бывали больше четырёх метров.
statement.en: The antlers of the ancient giant deer could span more than four metres.

why: Irish elk antlers could span over 4.2 m, the largest of any known deer.

statement.ru: Топор «ледяного человека» Эци был каменным.
statement.en: The axe of Ötzi the Iceman was made of stone.

why: Ötzi carried a copper axe with a yew handle.

statement.ru: Швейные иглы с ушком придумали ещё в каменном веке.
statement.en: Sewing needles with an eye were invented back in the Stone Age.

why: Eyed bone needles are known from 45,000 to 25,000 years ago.

statement.ru: Кислород был в воздухе Земли с самого её рождения.
statement.en: Earth's air has had oxygen ever since the planet was born.

why: Oxygen built up only about 2.4 billion years ago, made by photosynthesising cyanobacteria.

statement.ru: Во Франции есть пещера, где нарисовано больше сотни мамонтов.
statement.en: In France there is a cave with more than a hundred mammoths painted in it.

why: Rouffignac is called the Cave of the Hundred Mammoths for its many mammoth drawings.

statement.ru: Смилодон, саблезубая кошка, жил в Америке.
statement.en: Smilodon, the sabre-toothed cat, lived in America.

why: Smilodon lived in the Americas from 2.5 million to about 10,000 years ago.

statement.ru: Древние люди обводили свою ладонь на стене, выдувая краску вокруг руки.
statement.en: Ancient people outlined their hands on walls by blowing paint around them.

why: Hand stencils, like those at Cueva de las Manos, were made by spraying pigment through a pipe around the hand.
